description: Search Drint's library of ready 3D packaging and print mockups (about a thousand models: paper boxes, rigid gift boxes, paper bags, shipping cartons, bottles, jars, cans, cups, labels, flexible pouches, mugs, apparel, signage, posters, books, calendars). Use a few plain words for the product, e.g. "kraft paper bag", "tuck end box", "hộp quà Tết", "chai mỹ phẩm". Returns models with id, name, size in mm and a picture; shows them as a grid the user can click to open in 3D.

lang.description: The user's language (vi, en, th, zh…). Default en.

query.description: What to look for, a few words, English or Vietnamese.

name: search_mockups
title: Find mockups
